prompts.title: Yakuza Boss — Cinematic Kabukicho Night Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Convert the uploaded full-body photo into a cinematic Yakuza-themed portrait. The subject should embody the aura of a formidable Japanese crime boss, dressed in a sleek black tailored suit with an open-neck white shirt (no tie). Allow faint glimpses of traditional irezumi tattoos—dragon and koi patterns—emerging naturally from the chest and collar, detailed yet understated. Polished black leather shoes complete the look. Post-Processing: Apply filmic color grading with neon accents, subtle grain, and high contrast to emphasize the texture of the suit. Enhance reflections on the wet ground, sharpen facial details, and keep skin tone and body proportions true to the source photo.

Output: 4:3 ratio, 8K resolution, with a glossy cinematic finish.
